name: composite_breadth_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: Market breadth — the proportion of stocks advancing versus declining — provides information about the strength or weakness of an index move that price alone cannot convey. A NIFTY 50 rally driven by only 10-15 stocks (narrow breadth) is fragile, while a rally with 35+ advancers (broad breadth) is sustainable. By computing a composite intraday breadth indicator from 1-min advances/declines across NIFTY 50, we can identify divergences: index rising but breadth deteriorating (sell signal), or index falling but breadth improving (buy signal). The inefficiency persists because real-time breadth computation across 50 stocks requires infrastructure that most retail traders lack, and institutional desks focus on their own book rather than market-wide breadth at 1-min frequency.
mechanism: Multiple independent signals confirming the same direction increase the probability that a genuine order flow imbalance exists, not just noise. When momentum, volume, and volatility signals align, it indicates that institutional activity is creating measurable market impact across multiple dimensions simultaneously, increasing the confidence of directional prediction.

conditions: NIFTY_Trend < 0 (NIFTY falling) AND Breadth_EMA > 0.55 (majority advancing despite index fall)
Breadth_Divergence > 0 (positive divergence — breadth stronger than index)
Target stock: close < vwap AND ROC(close, 10) < -10 bps (lagging the breadth signal)
NIFTY_Trend > 0 (NIFTY rising) AND Breadth_EMA < 0.45 (majority declining despite index rise)
Breadth_Divergence < 0 (negative divergence — breadth weaker than index)
Target stock: close > vwap AND ROC(close, 10) > 10 bps (leading the narrow rally)

exit.signal_exit: Breadth_Divergence returns to zero (index and breadth re-align)

filters.volume_filter: At least 40 of 50 NIFTY stocks must have traded in the last 5 bars

weaknesses: Breadth divergences can persist for 1-3 hours before resolving — NIFTY can continue rallying on narrow breadth, causing premature short entries to be stopped out
Using ROC(close, 5) for advance/decline classification is sensitive to the lookback — a 5-bar lookback is noisy and can flip rapidly, creating false breadth signals
The target stock selection (most dislocated from breadth signal) adds a subjective element and may select stocks with idiosyncratic reasons for their dislocation (news, earnings, etc.)
prior_art: NYSE Advance-Decline Line (McClellan Oscillator); Zweig Breadth Thrust; intraday breadth less documented but used by institutional trading desks; Quantopian community explored similar concepts
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
